export default "# Inter-Knot Privacy Policy\n\n*Last updated: March 31, 2026*\n\n## 1. Overview\n\nInter-Knot is a community-driven leaderboard platform for Zenless Zone Zero. We aim to keep things simple: we only\ncollect the data we actually need to make the service work, and we do not sell or share your data.\n\nThis policy explains what we collect, why we collect it, and what rights you have under applicable data protection laws,\nincluding the GDPR.\n\nIf you have any questions, you can contact us at **[contact@interknot.space](mailto:contact@interknot.space)**.\n\n---\n\n## 2. What Data We Collect\n\nThe website relies on public in-game profile data, which is fetched through a third-party\nservice ([Enka.Network](https://enka.network)). This data is necessary for the platform to function.\n\nWhen you create an account through Discord or Patreon, we store basic information such as your **email address**,\n**username**, **avatar URL**, and your **user ID** from the provider if available. Authentication tokens are\n**never** stored and are discarded immediately after use.\n\nWe also collect **limited technical information** to operate and improve the service. This includes your **browser’s\nuser agent**, **basic usage data** (such as visited routes and request parameters), and **error logs** when something\ngoes wrong.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Cookies\n\nCookies are used to store your **session information** after logging in. The session expires automatically after\n30 days.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)\n\nYour data is primarily processed within the European Union. Under the GDPR, we process your data based on the following\nlegal grounds:\n\n* **Performance of a contract**: to provide the core functionality of the service (accounts, builds, leaderboards)\n* **Legitimate interests**: to monitor performance, improve the service, and ensure security\n* **Consent**: where applicable (for example, if optional features or third-party services are introduced in the future)\n\n---\n\n## 5. Third Parties\n\nWe do not sell or share your personal data.\n\nWe rely on certain third-party services where necessary, such as authentication providers and hosting infrastructure.\nThese providers only process data as needed to deliver their services.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Data Retention\n\nWe keep your data only for as long as necessary to operate the service.\n\nAccount data remains stored until you request deletion. Technical logs and error reports are kept for a limited time and\nare regularly cleaned up.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Your Rights\n\nUnder the GDPR, you have the right to access your data, request correction, request deletion, and restrict or object to\ncertain types of processing.\n\nTo exercise any of these rights, email us at **[contact@interknot.space](mailto:contact@interknot.space)**, and we will\nrespond within a reasonable timeframe (1-2 business days, but usually faster).\n\n---\n\n## 8. Security\n\nWe take reasonable steps to protect your data. The site is served over HTTPS, authentication tokens are not stored, and\nsensitive data may be encrypted before it reaches our servers.\n\n---\n\n## 9. Communication\n\nWe do not send marketing emails. We will only contact you if it is necessary for service-related reasons, such as\ncritical issues or important updates.\n\n---\n\n## 10. Changes to This Policy\n\nThis privacy policy is stored in a public [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Night-Sky-Studio/interknot), and any\nchanges are transparent and visible through version history.\n\n---\n\n## 11. Contact\n\nIf you have any questions or requests regarding your data, you can contact us at: **[contact@interknot.space](mailto:contact@interknot.space)**\n"
